title: ApiError
description: Canonical error response envelope used across all AgroShift API endpoints.

error_code.description: Standardized uppercase error code (e.g. INVALID_COORDINATES, UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT, NOT_FOUND).

message.description: Human-readable explanation of failure with remediation guidance.

details.description: Optional contextual dictionary or list with field validation hints or stack traces.

request_id.description: Unique correlation identifier for distributed tracing and error auditing.
